aboutText: Based in Melbourne, OZWARM Home Services has been providing professional heating solutions for years. Our team specializes in repairs, replacements, installations, and maintenance for all types of heaters, including gas ducted heating, gas log fires, wall furnaces, room heaters, and split system air-conditioners. We understand Melbourne's climate and ensure your home stays comfortable year-round with our comprehensive services.
servicesText: OZWARM Home Services offers a full range of heating and air-conditioning services in Melbourne. From installations and repairs to regular maintenance, we handle gas ducted heating, log fires, wall furnaces, room heaters, and split systems. Our team ensures efficient and reliable service for all your HVAC needs.
